excerpt: Not all cotton is the same. Compare mulmul, cambric, kota doria and hand block printed cotton kurta sets – feel, transparency, care and the best choice for office, travel and festivals.
seo_title: Cotton Kurta Sets for Women: Mulmul vs Cambric vs Kota Doria
seo_description: Compare cotton kurta set fabrics – mulmul, cambric, kota doria and hand block print cotton – for comfort, sheerness, care and occasion. Buyer's guide.
body:
## Quick answer

For everyday comfort, choose **cambric cotton** (soft, not see-through). For hot, humid days, **mulmul** is the lightest. For a festive but breathable look, a **kota doria** dupatta or kurta adds a fine checked texture. And for something truly handmade, pick **hand block printed cotton** from Jaipur. A good 3-piece cotton kurta set costs about **$35–$55** abroad.

## Cotton fabrics compared

| Fabric | Feel | Sheer? | Best for | Care |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cambric cotton | Smooth, soft, medium weight | No | Office, daily wear | Easy machine/hand wash |
| Mulmul cotton | Very soft, light, airy | Slightly | Summer, home, travel | Gentle hand wash |
| Kota doria | Fine checked weave (khat), crisp, airy | Yes | Dupattas, festive day wear | Gentle wash, starch optional |
| Hand block print cotton | Depends on base (usually cambric or mulmul), natural colours | Usually no | Everyday to festive | Cold wash, dry in shade |
| Flex / poplin cotton | Firm, holds shape | No | Structured kurtas, embroidery base | Easy wash |

## Which cotton for which occasion?

- **Office:** cambric or block print cotton, straight kurta + pants, pastel or indigo.
- **Summer travel:** mulmul or block print co-ords – they dry fast and breathe.
- **Festive day events:** a block print kurta with a **kota doria dupatta** – light but special.
- **Puja and family events:** embroidered cotton (thread work) in soft colours.

See our [cotton kurta pant dupatta sets](/shop/cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-sets/) and [hand block print kurta sets](/hand-block-print-kurta-sets/).

## How to tell real hand block print

Look for tiny shifts in the pattern, slightly uneven edges and colour soaking through to the back of the fabric. Screen prints look perfectly identical. Full guide: [hand block print vs screen print](/blog/hand-block-print-vs-screen-print-how-to-tell-the-difference/).

## Care for cotton kurta sets

1. Wash the first time separately in cold water – natural dyes may release a little colour.
2. Use mild detergent, turn inside out, dry in shade.
3. Iron while slightly damp for a crisp finish.
4. Kota doria dupattas look best with light starch.

More: [how to wash block printed cotton](/blog/how-to-wash-and-care-for-block-printed-cotton-kurtis/).

## Frequently asked questions

**Which cotton is best for a kurta set?**
Cambric cotton for everyday comfort and no transparency; mulmul for very hot weather.

**Is kota doria cotton?**
Kota doria is a fine woven fabric from Kota, Rajasthan, made from cotton or cotton-silk, known for its small checked pattern.

**Do cotton kurta sets shrink?**
Good pre-washed cotton shrinks very little. Wash cold and avoid hot tumble drying.

**Is hand block print cotton good for daily wear?**
Yes – it is breathable and soft, and the colours soften beautifully with every wash.
